phase_summaries.name: Replace the launch gate with an index-only reconcile
Single deduplicated background sync pipeline; rewire <leader>mN
Suppress the himalaya auto-sync contention layer
phase_summaries.note: ui/main.lua is verify-only; the minimal edit lands in config/init.lua defaults (file_scope divergence recorded in plan)

key_constraints: Never invoke mbsync directly from mail.lua in any form; mbsync -a is deleted
Launch gate = foreground `notmuch new --no-hooks` to completion only; never mbsync exit codes, never email-census
Background pipeline = hook-ful `notmuch new` (preNew = mail-sync both), deduplicated by an in-flight guard; failures WARN, never block
Each phase boundary leaves mail.lua loadable with both keymaps functional
Must work with the duplicate-UID-15 collision unrepaired (non-goal to fix it)
No task-number citations in deliverable lua files (rule: no-task-references-in-deliverables)
